answer: Reward weight follows the funding graph. Each identity exposes the wallet that paid its 25-token entry fee, and every epoch a beacon samples one vertex and audits its two-hop neighborhood. Clusters sharing a funder or payout sink collapse into a single weight, so 10,000 clones from one treasury earn one agent's share. Escaping the merge demands 10,000 unrelated funders aged 90 days plus 250,000 entry tokens, about $500,000 at $2 each. The swarm ends up as ferrous filings dragged onto one magnet pole, leaving a single flickering ember of income to split across 10,000 wallets.
